description.zh-Hans: 万千破碎世界的哀嚎中，一个古老的声音选中了你。你将化身为「摆渡人」，在虚无与现实之间架起希望的桥梁。面对两个亟待拯救的世界：一边是病房中用蜡笔画桥的患病孩子，需要你用勇气之光重绘生命；另一边是镜廊中对峙的过去与未来自我，等待你用智慧调和信念的冲突。
description.en: In the wailing of countless shattered worlds, an ancient voice has chosen you. You will become a 'ferryman', building a bridge of hope between nothingness and reality. Facing two worlds in desperate need of salvation: on one side, a sick child in a hospital room drawing bridges with crayons, needing you to redraw life with the light of courage; on the other side, past and future selves confronting each other in a mirror corridor, waiting for you to reconcile conflicts of belief with wisdom.
